title: Schedule of Enrollment Change Effective Dates and Education Debt Types
content:
**Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) — terms that govern a reduction in credits or a withdrawal, and the debt type an overpayment is established under.**

| Tier | Credit hours first dropped that are excused as mitigating without evidence (one time only) | Change effective date without mitigating circumstances | Change effective date with mitigating circumstances | Tuition and fees overpayment from a change before the term start is the school's debt | Debt type for an overpayment to the student | Debt type for a tuition and fees overpayment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | No | Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | Not applicable |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | No | Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | Not applicable |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | No | Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | Not applicable |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | Yes | Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | Yes | Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | Yes | Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | Yes | Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | 6 | Term start date | Last date of attendance | Yes | Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment |

**Schedule notes**

- The 6 credit hours are an allowance a student has once: they cover the first credit hours the student ever drops, and are not renewed term by term.
- The two effective-date columns are the same on every tier: the term start date where VA has not accepted mitigating circumstances, the last date of attendance where it has.
- The flat-rate chapters have no tuition and fees debt type because they pay no tuition to schools; the debt type names in the table are the official names under which the debt is established.
